report.summary: The Nova delivery ledger for the period 2026Q1-2026Q3 provides a detailed record of on-time orders and committed orders for approved Nova sample records. It exposes the eligible cohort and the denominator necessary to calculate the weighted on-time delivery metric using the formula sum(on_time_orders) / sum(committed_orders).
